bonus_attack_paths.title: Vendor invoice redirection
bonus_attack_paths.impact: Business email compromise and payment diversion
steps: Identify vendors or finance contacts from public posts and inbox context
Send a believable invoice update from a lookalike domain
Use urgency and role context to bypass normal review
Redirect payment before reconciliation catches the issue
bonus_attack_paths.fix: Add callback verification, vendor-change approvals, and payment anomaly alerts.

bonus_attack_paths.title: Recruiter lure with malicious document
bonus_attack_paths.impact: Malware delivery or credential capture through a career pretext
steps: Use employment history to craft a realistic recruiter message
Send a role description or compensation file
Route the target to a fake SSO or document portal
Use the captured credentials for account pivoting
bonus_attack_paths.fix: Train high-risk staff on recruiter lures and isolate document preview workflows.

bonus_attack_paths.title: Helpdesk reset impersonation
bonus_attack_paths.impact: Unauthorized password reset through social engineering
steps: Collect employer, title, phone, and location hints
Call helpdesk with a time-sensitive access story
Answer lightweight verification using public data
Reset the account and enroll attacker-controlled MFA
bonus_attack_paths.fix: Require stronger helpdesk verification and alert on MFA re-enrollment.
